entities.summary: Tonye Princewill is a Nigerian investor, politician, film producer and philanthropist Currently the Paramount ruler of Da Ogo / Queen Elebabene Royal Group of Houses. He was the 2015 and 2007 candidate. for Governor of Rivers State. He was a member of the All Progressives Congress (APC) and the son of King T.J.T. Princewill of the Kalabari Kingdom of Rivers State, Nigeria. He resigned from All Progressives Congress APC because of same faith presidential ticket by the party.
